name: ModelVariant106_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant106_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a twisting triangle fan and a banded dome that walks to the opponent); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the dome, ring and fan points and packs the texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0, 1, 2 or 4 by progress; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-123 and 253 images build it unchanged. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
